title: Dendritic Forest Management (HDFM framework)
description: Open-source landscape planning around roads and waterways: reproducible geometric assessments, a self-hosted web workspace and experimental Hierarchical Dendritic Forest Management research tools.
notes: Status: software pilot and working research, not peer reviewed and not field-validated. The geometric screening tools do not establish ecological viability, regulatory compliance or an optimal plan. AI use: much of the code and documentation was written with AI coding assistants (mainly Claude by Anthropic, some OpenAI Codex); Justin D. Hart reviews the changes and is the accountable author. No AI tool is listed as an author.
